about.lead: Ministry arm of Operation Christmas Child International serving every Christian church across Chile.
about.subTitle: Reaching every child and family in Chile
paragraphs: OCC Chile is a ministry that God uses as a tool to help Chilean churches carry out their evangelistic mission.

We firmly believe that starting with evangelism to children is the way an entire family can be reached with the Word of God. That is why thousands of believers around the world volunteer to pack shoeboxes with toys, new clothes, personal hygiene items, coloring books, colored pencils, crayons, stickers, and other simple items that put a smile on a child's face and a clear picture of God's love in their heart.

OCC Chile is an arm of Operation Christmas Child International (OCC) that has expanded into Chile. Today Operation Christmas Child operates in over one hundred countries and has distributed more than one hundred million shoebox gifts to boys and girls worldwide.

For seven years we have labored across Chile, and in this new season we want to reach boys and girls in every city through the dedicated, selfless service of all Christian churches, their pastors, leaders, and servants. We make no distinction among people, because we believe the Gospel must be preached in every circumstance and by everyone who calls themselves a son or daughter of God.
about.invitationQuote: “We invite you to serve alongside us. If your desire is to work so that the message of salvation reaches the ears of every person in Chile, you are in the right place.”
about.mediaCaption: Every shoebox opens a door to share the Good News with the whole family.

meta.title: Mission & History · OCC Chile · AI Platform
meta.description: Mission and history of Operation Christmas Child Chile (Samaritan's Purse): how it began in 1990 and our three-part mission.

hero.subtitle: The mission of Operation Christmas Child is to demonstrate God's love in a tangible way to children in need around the world, and together with the local church worldwide, to share the Good News of Jesus Christ.

origin.subtitle: From a nine-truck convoy in 1990 to a global network reaching millions of children with hope.
origin.cardTitle: A compassionate response that crossed borders
paragraphs: In October 1990, Dave Cooke, a businessman from the United Kingdom, watched a news report on the war in Romania and children abandoned in orphanages. He could not stop the war, but he could show them they were not forgotten.
He rallied friends and family to collect gifts. That is how Operation Christmas Child began: a convoy of nine trucks and 17 volunteers driving to Romania with shoeboxes filled with gifts.
Today, as a project of Samaritan's Purse, shoeboxes reach over 100 countries. In Chile, national and regional volunteer teams make every season possible.
origin.timelineAria: Historical milestones of Operation Christmas Child

milestones.text: Samaritan's Purse is founded, bringing spiritual and physical aid to hurting people.
First shoebox convoy sets out for Romania.
Millions of children in over 100 countries receive a shoebox and hear the Gospel.
ENL, ERLE, and ERL teams mobilize churches from north to south.
